source.title: Crate of Dreambound Armor - Warcraft Wiki

quote: Contains a random piece of bind on account armor for your class.
notes: Crate 209833 contains one of 32 Dreambound armor TOKENS, not a directly equipped soulbound item. The 32 names are explicitly listed by Warcraft Wiki; 15 IDs corroborated by linked Wowhead item pages, remaining IDs intentionally null. Actual outcome restricted to the opening character's armor class; no chance distribution or current level scaling is asserted. Wowhead crate item page independently confirms the item ID and a player comment reports receiving an account-bound armor token.
